etymology: English: the box under the article - named for the conversation it was meant to continue.
carriers: Article comments, video replies, live chats, and the replies under the replies.
economics: Engagement: replies, quote-posts, dwell time. Nobody in it is being paid, and everything in it is being monetised.
signature: One sentence, no context, and a number next to a username.

confused_with.tell: The panel is paced and produced; the comment section is feral and asynchronous. Both are venues for the verdict.

senses: The space under a published thing where the public answers it in public, at a speed and volume that no editor ever intended.

It rewards the reply that travels over the reply that is right. Because the cheapest sentence to write is a verdict, the habitat selects for verdicts - which is why so many of the fallacies filed at the end of this chapter are at home here.
example: *"Four hundred comments under a budget story, and not one of them about the budget - three about the mayor's brother, two hundred about each other, and a bot selling a supplement."*
